name: @allfantasy/widget-iframe
description: AllFantasy Widget SDK — iframe embed adapter (Phase 7.9-7.15): versioned postMessage protocol, origin/sandbox validation, host/child bootstraps, browser DOM wiring, and host/child facades. Four independent entry points so a non-React consumer never pulls in React: '.' (protocol, no DOM), './browser' (DOM wiring), './facade' (host/client facades), './react-child' (composes @allfantasy/widget-react, the one sanctioned adapter-depends-on-adapter exception). Consumes only the frozen lib/decision-os/sdk + lib/decision-os/presentation/widget-contracts contracts (PHASE_7_5_WIDGET_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_ADR.md, D4 of PHASE_7_22_SDK_PACKAGING_ADR.md).

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.facade.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.reactChild.json
